graph.scope: Exact decimal candidate and duals; outward exponential enclosures. No Perron accuracy or optimizer optimality assumption.

constants.scope: Uniform correction to Q_n for all n>=n_min, conditional on the proved spectral lemma. This file does not enclose Q_n or Q_infinity.

infinite.scope: True infinite-chain expectation for the fixed range-R candidate. No finite-size extrapolation. Does not by itself enclose the tilted generator spectral density.

timing.scope: verification only; excludes candidate/seed generation, imports and result writing; graph includes candidate reading
